steps.objective: Reach the gate at the end of the road.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text:
The rows are vanishing, Tilde.
Take the road. Warn the Lighthouse.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text:
`h` `j` `k` `l`. Left, down, up, right.
One key, one step.

lines.speaker: sign
lines.text:
A Blot. It moves only when you move.
It hurts only if you share its tile.

lines.speaker: scribe
lines.text:
A Save Stone. I left these for you.
Soon you will learn what they are for.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: The gate opens. Beyond it, more road.
